stage: follow-up after observing the frozen 42-group P30 pilot
purpose: Strengthen the group-information comparator, inspect contract-relative reliability and days-to-pay, and describe sample selection
disclosure: These checks are exploratory follow-up, not an untouched confirmation sample
outcomes: Percentage of SB invoices paid within Payment Term
group_information: Group most common contractual payment term
estimation: Ridge regression with intercept; training-fold standardization, group-equal weights. Penalty chosen by deterministic ABN-grouped five-fold cross-validation on the first two chronological transitions only, grid [0,0.01,0.1,1,10,100]. Identical test rows for both information sets.
holdout: 2025H2 to 2026H1 as before. P30 and on-time-share predictions clipped to [0,100] for both models; mean days clipped at zero.
samples: Secondary: adjacent exact-name matches across complete valid multi-active-segment reports, allowing segment sets to vary; training on first two transitions, evaluation on third
bounds: Re-run rounding-relaxation LP with the strict 0.015001pp distribution-sum filter and 0.5pp component rounding sensitivity; validate feasibility residuals and known analytic examples
historical_link: Require all six old number bands to sum to 100 within 0.030001pp; remove nil/all-zero rows, retain only groups with at least two active reporters. Report relation to new report type as disclosure allocation, not treatment assignment or stable ownership certification.
interpretation: Error gains quantify published segment information content in a revised snapshot, not credit losses or the causal effect of mandatory disclosure. Rich group-only models can improve, match or beat local models.
